data.training_prompt: mc45preview, a clean Minecraft character skin preview sheet showing the same full-body character twice, front-left three-quarter orthographic view on the left and back-left three-quarter orthographic view on the right, both exposing the character's left side, fixed 45-degree elevated camera, identical scale and neutral standing pose in both views, exact classic block proportions, crisp square texels painted directly on valid Minecraft base and outer skin layers, pure white background, no shadows, no floor, no text, no labels, no interface, no props, no weapons, no extra geometry
